description: Portions cyclables appartenant au réseau des véloroutes et voies vertes dans le département des Vosges is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoinformations.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. Bicycle roads and green roads are part of a national policy implemented by the Ministry responsible for ecology for the development of cycling and cycling.A portion of a cycle route is a part of a bicycle road specifically identified for its particular role in relation to this main itinerary.Four types of cycling portion characterise the ... Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Bicycle portions belonging to the network of bicycle roads and green roads in the Vosges department" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include données ouvertes, vélo. The listing shows 2016-07-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
